(b) 'Nieuwe betaling' button opens PaymentForm modal (data-testid='payment-modal') successfully. (c) Mobile viewport (390x844) still renders payments-mobile POS terminal container unchanged. (d) Search bar + MonthStepper still function (used prev to step 2 months back). Visual parity with Betalingsregelingen PlanRow (PaymentPlans.jsx L94–121) is confirmed structurally identical.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate data-testid values on desktop+mobile trees: 'month-stepper', 'month-stepper-label', 'month-prev', 'month-next' each render twice (once inside md:hidden mobile container, once inside hidden md:block desktop container). Playwright strict mode fails on such selectors. Recommend suffixing (e.g., month-stepper-mobile / month-stepper-desktop) or gating with matchMedia. Non-blocking but harms testability.
Payments.jsx is 1191 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting PaymentRow, MobilePaymentCard, PendingPaymentCard, ApprovePaymentSheet, PaymentForm, MonthStepper into separate files.
'tab' state (line 708) is fixed to 'month' and never changes but a useState is still used with unused setter — dead branches (tab === 'today' / 'week') can be removed.
